newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steady to firmer in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steady to firmer in thin trade.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were steady to firmer in early trade on Thursday.
Traders said there was a lot of discussion for several different specs but though buying interest was quite strong, it was still pretty relaxed and trade was thin.

Discussion for pipeline spec continued to peg around the mid $220 a tonne level with one trading house looking to cover a short position, but traders said there was little urgency to this with the trader running a heft swaps position against it.
LVN barrrels talked around benchmark quotes high +$2 a tonne with full range a dollar lower.
